items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: These are the earlier people who I saw and I came into the band with, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Manuel Powell, Paul Crawford. There was another guy, his name was Jim something. Oh no, we had, well sometime Chicken Hendry and Oscar would come over and play with us, and William Brown on tuba and so forth. These are the earlier people who I saw and I came into the band with, you know.
How, Dejon wanted you in the band?
